title: Emergency Withdraw Solvency
summary: A staking pool lets users borrow against staked liquidity and withdraw. A position must still be solvent after every withdrawal, including the emergency path. Deposits, borrows, repayments and withdrawals that leave the position solvent must keep working.

realWorld.incident: Platypus Finance MasterPlatypusV4 emergencyWithdraw, 2023-02-16 19:16 UTC, Avalanche
realWorld.lossReported: About $8.5M in the primary attack (Omniscia estimated ~$8,529,854; CertiK ~$8.5M). The team later reported $9.1M across three attacks the same day.
realWorld.rootCause: emergencyWithdraw checked solvency before it reduced the staked LP, so the check still saw the pre-withdraw collateral and the LP could be withdrawn while the debt remained.
realWorld.note: Minimal reproduction of the check-order bug. Re-implemented from the public post-mortems. The DeFiHackLabs PoC is MIT and is cited only; none of its code is copied.
